common_conditions: RFC3261 baseline dialog rules; not a complete MCX SIP profile
condition_rule: Inherit common_conditions and add claim conditions.

conditions: Identifying a dialog at a UA
claims.conclusion: Dialog ID consists of Call-ID, local tag and remote tag; Call-ID alone is not the full key.

conditions: Generating an in-dialog request as UAC
claims.conclusion: Empty route set: remote target is Request-URI, no Route. First route has lr: remote target is Request-URI, ordered full route set is Route. Otherwise: first route becomes Request-URI with disallowed parameters removed, remaining routes followed by remote target form Route.
Target refresh can change remote target, not the route set. Non-target-refresh requests do not change remote target; ACK is not a target refresh.

limitations: Baseline RFC3261 only; extension updates, MCX profile, transaction matching, transport reuse and failover not fully checked.
RFC has no 3GPP Release; placement under Rel19 is navigational, not a new Rel19 rule.
